title: Bracket negation rewrite breaks incomplete brackets and literalBrackets
prompt: Our picomatch turns a leading '!' in a bracket expression into a negation, so '[!abc]' acts like '[^abc]'. That rewrite is too eager. A pattern with an incomplete bracket such as '*x[!]y' (there is no closing bracket after the '!') should still match the literal text 'zx[!]y' and 'zx!y' as before, while '[!]]' must still negate a closing bracket. With the option literalBrackets: true, '*x[!a]y' must keep matching the literal text 'zx[!a]y' and 'x[!a]y' must not match 'xby'. Please fix it in lib/parse.js.
